label: Exploratory V5 C4 with Cast Threadstep reaction candidate G1
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, reward, UI, or asset authority.
It retains Candidate C4's ideal-direct-hit range/damage values, forward-only Needlepoint Seam Pin, and equal non-refilling 128-unit Escape Slack reserve.

After a caster has declared an otherwise in-band cast, but before its ideal direct damage resolves, the target may Threadstep one full 64-unit normal separation move. The target pays that existing Escape Slack only when the exact legal step places it outside that Relic's launch band, so a Threadstep changes position and a bounded reserve rather than negating damage for free.

The transparent retreat-kite, best-response, and candidate-only threadstep-counter policies choose that reaction only when it turns the declared cast into a miss; the other primary policies decline it. The bounded opening search instead gives the target both legal choices, so a forced opening must survive a credible reaction.
Fire still ends the caster's turn. Terrain, aim, splash, animation, UI, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
